what: CP4 · the one comps engine's artifact: every reading every screen prints. One program (deliverables/20261007/comps-engine/tools/engine.mjs) wrote this file and names/<TICKER>.json; the Hub's COMPS tab, the cards, the knockout and the allocation tool read them and compute nothing of their own.
price_is: the 2026-10-06 regular-session close (chart API /quotes, captured 2026-10-07T03:57:17Z); a screen with a fresh live price divides it by the same earnings and scales the range by price ÷ close

rule.forward: price ÷ the next four quarters of consensus EPS (the dashboard's rule, lib/forward-basis.mjs); a foreign reporter's EPS in dollars at the supplier's own paired rate
rule.growth: the four quarters after the next four ÷ the next four − 1
rule.peg: that forward P/E ÷ that growth — the PEG ratio, called PEG everywhere

prior.words: growth and PEG weigh most (Alan's rule); each weight on the page is prior × coverage × fit, measured in the set, then halved where the consistency check flags the yardstick

rule.peers: the four sources vote (FMP peers, Massive related, same industry, shared fund); business lines from the filings decide membership; same-business peers set the price when at least 4 exist and adjacent peers blend in at 0.35; every peer weighed by closeness (size ÷ 0.7 decade, growth ÷ 30 points, margin ÷ 20 points)
rule.consistency: a yardstick whose implied price is more than ×1.5 from the weighted middle of the others is flagged with its reason and its weight is cut: to half at ×1.5, and by the square of the distance beyond (a tenth at ×3)
rule.debt: discount off the centre: 0% up to 2.5×, 3% up to 4×, 6% up to 6×, 10% above; + 1% per year of free cash flow beyond 5 to repay all debt (cap 5%)
